body: Take a few minutes and do this on behalf of the people of Sudan. 4.9 million Sudanese – nearly 1 in 8 – don’t have a home to call their own, having been displaced by violence. You can add your voice to the call for action. It’s one of those small actions that can help make a difference when enough of us speak up.
